body:
## Summary

Fixes issue #957 — the level clear message (score screen) was not properly displayed after clearing the City level.

### Root Causes Found

**1. `city_level.gd` — missing `_show_fallback_score_screen()` method**

When `animated_score_screen.gd` fails to load (e.g., Godot 4.3 binary tokenization bug), `city_level.gd` called `_show_victory_message()` in its `else` branch — which shows only a simple "CITY CLEARED!" label with **no score data and no navigation buttons**. All other level scripts (`docks_level.gd`, `beach_level.gd`, `revolver_level.gd`, `labyrinth_level.gd`, `building_level.gd`, `test_tier.gd`) correctly call `_show_fallback_score_screen(ui, score_data)` that shows rank, total score, and Restart/Level Select buttons.

**2. `city_level.gd` — missing `_get_rank_color()` helper**

The fallback score screen needs `_get_rank_color(rank)` to display ranks in the correct color (gold for S, red for F, etc.). This function existed in all other level scripts but was absent from `city_level.gd`.

**3. `city_level.gd` — replay button always shown (regression from Issue #807)**

The `_add_score_screen_buttons()` in `city_level.gd` always added the Watch Replay button without checking `ExperimentalSettings.is_replay_enabled()`. Issue #807 required that replay is only shown when enabled in experimental settings — this fix was applied to all other levels but missed in city_level.gd.

**4. `LevelInitFallback.cs` — `animation_completed` signal never connected**

`ShowScoreScreen()` loaded and called `show_animated_score(ui, scoreData)` on the animated score screen, but never connected the `animation_completed` signal. After the animation finished, `OnScoreAnimationCompleted` was never called, so navigation buttons (Restart, Level Select) never appeared — leaving players with no way to navigate after seeing the score animation.

### Changes

- **`scripts/levels/city_level.gd`**: Added `_show_fallback_score_screen(ui, score_data)`, `_get_rank_color(rank)`, and fixed `_add_score_screen_buttons()` to check `ExperimentalSettings` before showing the replay button.
- **`Scripts/Components/LevelInitFallback.cs`**: Connected `animation_completed` signal in `ShowScoreScreen()` and added `OnScoreAnimationCompleted()` callback with Restart and Level Select buttons.
- **`tests/unit/test_level_scripts.gd`**: Added `MockCityLevel` class and comprehensive unit tests covering enemy tracking, level completion flow, rank colors, and next level path.

## Test Plan

- [x] Unit tests added for CityLevel (MockCityLevel): enemy tracking, level completion, rank colors, level ordering
- [x] All tests follow existing patterns from other level mock classes
- [x] Verified `_show_fallback_score_screen` is now consistent with all other level scripts
- [x] Verified `_get_rank_color` colors match all other levels
- [x] Replay button now correctly gated by `ExperimentalSettings.is_replay_enabled()`
- [x] `LevelInitFallback.cs` now shows navigation buttons after score animation
